dominant_strengths: Crisp SF typography hierarchy with confident scale jump from 'iPhone' headline to subheading reads instantly clean
Restrained neutral canvas lets the product photography carry color, a textbook Apple craft move
Global nav spacing, pill CTAs, and chrome match Apple.com conventions with high native fidelity
dominant_weaknesses: Composition feels static and template-bound — hero is essentially centered text over a product shot with no compositional risk
Innovation is near-zero; this is a faithful clone rather than a fresh interpretation of the Apple system
Section transition to 'MacBook Neo' is abrupt with weak vertical rhythm and no visual bridge between modules
fix_priorities: Introduce one distinctive compositional or motion idea (asymmetry, scroll-driven product reveal) to escape pure template mimicry
Tighten hero-to-second-section transition with consistent baseline grid and a transitional visual element
Push reflective layer via a subtler tagline or kinetic type moment to add memorability beyond the clone
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and solid visceral polish, but reflective distinctiveness is muted because it mirrors Apple rather than reinterpreting it.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it convincingly reproduces the Apple home aesthetic, though it leans imitative rather than creatively extending the brief.
